beats.line: Now lay a ruler along the blue search arrow. Where does each tip land?
Drop a straight line from each tip. Rotation lands at one. Audit reaches four.
That reach is the dot product with our unit query. Audit wins. Its extra length counts.
What if this search should reward direction alone? Keep both guides pointed where they are.
Slide each tip along its ray until both arrows are one unit long.
Look closely at the marks. Rotation now reaches farther along the query. That's the cosine score.
Keep those lengths. Which guide will point closer when the search turns straight up?
Turn the ruler with the query. Watch where the marks trade places.
Audit is closer to straight up. Its mark now reaches farther along the ruler.
